gpu_tip: ~33GB total at 128K context — the smallest K2 Horizon 32B build, for when nothing larger fits. Quality drops noticeably at 2-bit, and ~18GB of the total is KV cache, so the KV cache knob's q4_0 option is often the better saving. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 32GB DDR5 kit covers it via llama.cpp's layer offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~33GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro comfortably; a 36GB M4 Max or M5 Max is tight.
